ground_observation: Working golden triple-chevron Holovator on black/dark façade against paved sidewalk on South Boulevard. Maintenance/construction-clothed character stands to left and another person to right (Diantha-related speech bubble). Do not infer their identity or quest status from clothing or speech.
rooftop_observation: Owner-reported same-device rooftop arrival is a wide flat rooftop garden with rectangular blue-flower planters and bright pink Mega Crystals; ladder ahead on the facing building, slightly right of centre, and Investigate prompt near arrival pad. Roof ladder is a future candidate only: no climb, endpoints, height or exact city-map XY confirmed. Pink crystals are NOT evidence of a specific collectible Screw or item reward.
ground_position_proof: Owner red ring lies on gold chevron along north side of South Boulevard in 7393–7395. Existing W04/W10 photo candidate WIDE-H04 researched near (706,1705) and (710,1706) city JPG; retain approximate consensus (708,1706) not claimed as independently aligned exact door.
recommended_directions: From Nouveau Café (Truck No. 2) or the Bleu Pokémon Center, proceed east along South Boulevard on the south side of Bleu Sector 7. Look for the functional golden Holovator on the black façade of the north-side buildings before Vernal Avenue. If the lift is not repaired in a new save, Side Mission 045's Durstin requires a drink.
roof_route_reference: StrategyWiki Exploring Lumiose City describes a Colorful Screw route starting by the Holovator next to Bleu Sector 7 after Side Mission 045, but no exact item pickup location is authenticated from this five-photo batch.
